newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen B shares end up on A index rises.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen B shares end up on A index rises.

text.p: Shenzhen's B share index ended slightly up on Tuesday, but trading volume shrank due to a slowdown in the morning session during the funeral ceremony for Deng Xiaoping, brokers said.
The B index inched up 0.14 points or 0.09 percent to 150.87, with turnover falling to HK$85 million from Monday's HK$116 million.
The A share index rose 6.02 points or 1.66 percent to close at 368.70 on turnover of 6.35 billion yuan compared with 6.51 billion on Monay.
"Market sentiment is stable, reflecting investors' confidence in China's stability after Deng's death," an analyst said. "But the indices will face a technical correction later this week."
On the B share market, real estate developer China Vanke Co Ltd was the strongest performer, rising HK$0.13 or 2.22 percent to HK$5.99 on a thin volume of 37,386 shares.

Property concern Hainan Pearl River Enterprises Holding Co Ltd rose HK$0.08 or 2.18 percent to HK$3.75 after 1.35 million shares were changed hands. The counter was firmer due to expectation on improvement of its 1996 earnings.
Rises on the A share market were supported by government-related institutions, which gave a slight boost to the B share market, brokers said.
"But follow-up buying was not active with most investors slowing their trade to watch the funeral service for Deng Xiaoping," a broker with Shenzhen J&A Securities Co said.
Deng's funeral started at 10:00 a.m. (0200 GMT) on Tuesday and lasted for nearly one hour.
Analysts said they expected optimism over China's political stability to lift share prices in the medium term.
Building materials producer Shenzhen Fangda Industrial Co gained HK$0.17 to HK$9.03 on a technical rebound, with 1.40 million shares traded.
China Southern Glass Holdings traded most on volume of 1.43 million shares, down HK$0.02 to HK$4.90 on a technical correction, brokers said.
Ceramics producer Hebei Huayu Co Ltd registered a 10 percent limit-up rise to end at 13.17 yuan, up 1.20 yuan on volume of 2.45 million shares.
